name: mosquitto-rpc-qos2
notes: Release 086 (PREREG_extra_086.md, QB; reviewer comment M3(2), question Q6): the Mosquitto row at QoS 2 end to end. Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure mosquitto-qos2 (Mosquitto 2.0.20 on VM-B with docker compose, as measure mosquitto; on VM-E the reference device at QoS 2: python3 conformance/reference/mqtt_device_qos2.py --broker 192.168.107.152:1883 --device pump-mqtt-1 --plant http://127.0.0.1:18090 --admin-port 18201, subscriptions and replies at QoS 2, persistent session). The probe publishes its requests at QoS 2 and subscribes its replies at QoS 2 (adapters/mqtt5_qos2.py). Same probes, parameters, repetitions and fault proxy as mosquitto-rpc.json (the QoS 1 row); keepalive_s 60 exceeds the longest injected delay (P9T: 31.5 s).
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
